source: GAC Brand Identity Manual + guideline-kit.pdf (official files uploaded 12 Jun 2026)

primary.name: Pantone 307 C — Brand Blue
primary.usage: Primary brand color · headlines · key brand elements

green.name: Pantone 347 C — Green
green.usage: Subheadings · gradient end color · success states

header_gradient.description: Navy → Dark Green diagonal used on all official template headers

typography.primary_ar: Frutiger LT Arabic (GAC-approved; Light 300 / Roman 400 / Bold 700)
typography.primary_en: Frutiger LT Arabic (the approved face carries Latin as well)

logo.clear_space_ratio: Equal to the height of the brand symbol on all four sides (per Brand Manual §4.1)
logo.rule: ALWAYS use master file. NEVER rebuild, recolor, distort, or rotate the brand mark.

safe_zones.logo_zone: top-right quadrant of header — DO NOT place content here
safe_zones.header_zone: top 22% — reserved for logo + optional dept badge
safe_zones.body_left: left 40% (RTL: right 40%) — title + headings + body text
safe_zones.body_right: right 60% (RTL: left 60%) — imagery / icon grid / decorative
